productConcept.name: Ivoire Bureau
productConcept.description: A precision material reference studio that documents paper, textile, clay, and leather properties in limited numbered editions for studio craftspeople and institutions.
productConcept.rationale: The warm cream palette (#f5f0e8), Lora serif typography, restrained spacing, and concept_by_video.md describing artisanal material surfaces (linen, handmade paper, hands at work) all pointed to a specialist material documentation practice. The ivory-register color system and slow material cubic-bezier motion felt like the studio of someone who takes time with things — not a SaaS product, but a precision atelier that works with craft materials.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json contained named keyframes (fadeInUp), the material cubic-bezier (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) at 380ms scroll entries, and concept_by_video.md specified three video placements with ambient scroll behavior. All three signals pointed to GSAP + ScrollTrigger.
